headline: Banco Bradesco Loan Book Reaches BRL 1.1 Trillion in Q3
summary: Banco Bradesco reported in its third-quarter earnings call that its total loan portfolio exceeded BRL 1.1 trillion, while digital customer numbers reached 45 million.
why: Banco Bradesco is one of Brazil's largest private banks. Credit portfolio expansion offers insight into domestic consumer borrowing and corporate credit health.

impacts.name: Banco Bradesco S.A.
impacts.why: Surpassing BRL 1.1 trillion in loans reflects continuing expansion in core lending operations.
